children: Walker & Dunlop, Inc. announced today that it has arranged a $122,100,000 refinancing for 530 Fifth Avenue, a 58,989-square-foot retail condominium located along one of the world's most prominent retail corridors in Midtown Manhattan.

Walker & Dunlop Capital Markets Institutional Advisory served as exclusive advisor to Aurora Capital Associates and AVRS Partners, arranging a floating-rate, interest-only loan through Rialto Capital Management. Aaron Appel, Dustin Stolly, Jonathan Schwartz, Keith Kurland, Adam Schwartz, Sean Reimer, Jordan Casella, and Stanley Cayre arranged the financing.

“530 Fifth Avenue's combination of prime frontage, established tenancy, and location within one of the world's most recognized shopping destinations make it a highly attractive asset,” said Appel, senior managing director of Capital Markets and co-head of Institutional Advisory at Walker & Dunlop. “With the property fully leased and benefiting from strong in-place cash flow, this refinancing positions our client to capitalize on the long-term value of the asset. We appreciate the opportunity to work with Aurora Capital, AVRS Partners, and Rialto Capital Management on this transaction.”

Spanning the western block front of Fifth Avenue between 44th and 45th streets, the three-level retail condominium features approximately 200 feet of prime frontage and is 100% leased to five nationally recognized tenants, including Chase Bank, Walgreens, Five Below, Vans, and UGG. The property's diversified tenant mix provides established cash flow in one of the world's most prominent retail corridors.

Located between the luxury retail corridor of Upper Fifth Avenue and the high-traffic shopping destinations to the south, 530 Fifth Avenue benefits from its proximity to Grand Central Terminal, Bryant Park, Times Square, and Rockefeller Center. The surrounding concentration of office buildings, hotels, transit connections, and major tourist destinations supports consistent pedestrian activity and long-term retail demand.

In the first half of 2026, Walker & Dunlop’s Capital Markets team sourced over $13.9 billion from non-Agency capital providers, including nearly $9.6 billion for multifamily properties. This vast experience has made them a top advisor on all asset classes for many of the industry’s top developers, owners, and operators.
